page.layout: One folded sheet, unfolded to show four panels of faint print and ruled lines. No readable running text. The bottom edge carries one line of inverted print. The upper left corner shows the edge of a bound book.
page.notes: The scan shows a large folded sheet, mostly blank. Faint ruled lines and small boxed fragments appear across the panels, but they are too faint and fragmentary to read, so no words can be transcribed. The line at the bottom is printed upside down and is also illegible. The mirrored marks in the left panel look like show-through from the reverse side. The dark strip at the top left is the edge of the bound volume, not printed text. No page number, running head, catchword or signature can be made out.
